name: Entity Workflow Workspace
description: Provides a Draft/Review/Approved/Published workflow for workspaces whose Publish transition publishes the workspace and whose Unpublish transition reverts it (requires WSE).
project_description: Submodule of Entity Workflow. Installs a 'workspace' workflow (Draft, Ready for Review, Approved, Published) whose states carry locked/open-closed status, whose Publish transition publishes the workspace and whose Unpublish transition reverts it via WSE. Enforces per-transition permissions through the workspace entity access handler and locks content of locked/closed workspaces.
